entries.title: Extermination

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 with an owned PS2 copy for higher internal resolution and modern display options.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 presentation with optional emulator-side improvements.

primary.why: The North American PS2 release is the best practical English-language pick for a US audience; Extermination has no sourced higher-fidelity port, remaster, or remake.
primary.how_to_play: Play the North American PS2 disc on compatible hardware, or use PCSX2 with an owned copy for modern display options.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, or modern rerelease was identified.
